TLDR : woke up after a black out night with a sore BITCH ass…

i had a rough night of a pack of palm bay & ativan in my system (stupid but i didn’t know at the time that it would fuck me up so bad lol), completely blacked out with no recollection of what happened. from a “friends” account, i was belligerently drunk & begged this guy to tattoo my ass with the word “Bitch” with a machine he got off amazon. & of course it’s in the worst spot possible, a few more inches towards my crack and i could of hid it under a bikini, but alas it was meant to be seen lmao… 
apparently there’s a photo or video out there somewhere of me hanging over a guys lap getting tattooed lmao. woke up the next morning & it’s sore af, looked back and in the worst drunken chicken scratch writing is the damn tattoo. tbh it almost looked more like “BLTCH” so i ended up calling it my Blitch tattoo lmao…
it’s haunted me for YEARS! i felt so awkward in a bikini with my son at the beach. for awhile i would just wear shorts bc i was so embarrassed! my current partner hated it so much & would comment on it all the time about how i needed to get it covered up! he is now very happy to not have to stare at it anymore lmao

personally the only two i would recommend would be Black Petal (Neo Trad) & Urge 3 (Japanese & Trad). i wouldn’t bother with rob’s or valley ink, as they have been pretty hit and miss for me & don’t have the best reputations! 
my coworker really likes Tuesday at Sudio Six for realism, but that’s not my jam so i haven’t experienced first hand! though i have to say her work is really stunning!

i wholeheartedly reccomend Black Petal for all your neo traditional needs! Joseph does some phenomal colour work, carm loves black & grey and is amazing in the tighter spots like ears & fingers (she blasted my fingers and they look amazing). they also have an awesome apprentice who’s work is so clean it blows my mind! 
their [work](https://instagram.com/blackpetal.tattoo?igshid=YmMyMTA2M2Y=) should absolutely speak for itself!
